notes.title: New Game: Winged Sakura: Mindy's Arc 2!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/361790/Winged_Sakura_Mindys_Arc_2/

(Not required to play the prequel, Winged Sakura: Mindy's Arc to enjoy the game.)

The game will be available next Friday, April 26.

Winged Sakura: Mindy's Arc 2 is a RPG Tower Defense game that takes place around the same time as Demon Civil War, but is a prequel to the ending. The story is formatted similar to visual novels and have 15 Chapters over 2 Story Arcs.

The game uses a RPG system, such as boosting a unit's stat by equipping them with a weapon, armor, accessory or power. Each unit has specific roles, such as Tank, Attacker, or Supporter. 

The game consists of resource management, strategically placing units onto the battlefield, and defending specific objective(s).

----

All owners of Winged Sakura: Demon Civil War will obtain an exclusive Power during the 1st Chapter of the game.

A Power is a equippable item that provides a unique passive ability.

For anyone who wishes to preview what the Power does, see the spoiler below.

[spoiler]
How to unlock: View the following Side Stories in the HQ during Chapter 1: Troubled & Mindy's Punishment.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27028758/f9836612a241add157f82e8d94ceabc0cced8026.png[/img]

Materialize: Is another word for summon. Units are placed onto the battlefield, but have a Lifespan before it goes away.

Barrier: A magic shield that protects the unit and follows the unit around.

Freeze: Unit is frozen. While frozen, the unit is unable to move and is extremely vulnerable to Lightning attacks.
 [/spoiler]

We look forward to see what you think about our latest game. For more information, please click on Winged Sakura: Mindy's Arc 2's Steam Store page above or check out our website below.

Website: http://wingedsakura.com/mindysarc2/
WSMA2 Community Hub: https://steamcommunity.com/app/361790

notes.title: Winged Sakura: Endless Dream is now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
We just released our next new game on Steam!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/339250/Winged_Sakura_Endless_Dream/

Please also note that Luna's loyalty reward has been modified:

[h1]Old version[/h1]

Attacks gain 20% slow for 1 second. While Burst is active increase slow to 60% instead.

[h1]New version[/h1]

Attacks gain 40% slow for 1 second. While Burst is active increase slow to 75% instead.

Thank you and please do check out our new game!

notes.title: Winged Sakura: Demon Civil War Loyalty Rewards
notes.content:
We're releasing a new game on Steam this Friday! We've worked on this Project since Dec 2014. A new game means a new loyalty reward for our players!

Check out the game below!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/339250/Winged_Sakura_Endless_Dream/

All Winged Sakura: Demon Civil War owners will get Luna as a Sakura in Winged Sakura: Endless Dream (WSED.) In WSED, you can select up to 30 (+2) Sakuras and they each have unique powers that can change the way you play the game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27028758/de65c8e57815d93cb47b3a71d7d1503b0087e846.png[/img]

Luna changes your Element to Ice and applies a 20% slow on enemies you attack for 1 second. When Luna is placed as an Operator, ice enemies will no longer be immuned to slow, which will allow your towers or other Sakuras to apply slow on them.

In addition, for the duration of Burst (after activating class' unique skill), the slow is increased from 20% to 60%. On the .gif below, you can see Mindy activating the Archer's unique skill and enemies are slowed down by 60%.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27028758/dbc88bc9e8c9cf1abc11adb6ea600c3abd29cf0f.gif[/img]

Thank you for your continued support and please do check our new game out!

notes.title: 1/8/2017 Optimization Patch and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Quality[/h1]

Added 3 new Quality Options to the 'Gameplay' Option menu.
[list]
    [*]Fantastic (default)
    [*]Normal
    [*]Low
[/list]
If you are experiencing low FPS, try changing the quality to Normal or Low.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed all reported bugs up until Jan 6.
[/list]

notes.title: 12/11/2016 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fixed an achievement bug related to the last three bosses in the game. If you beat the final boss and ended up with 17/19 achievements, you can load your save file and the last two achievements will unlock.

If the last two achievements do not automatically unlock, check your Profile -> Journal -> Achievements Menu.

- Fixed a bug that makes the 'Escape' button disappear for several battles.

notes.title: 12/10/2016 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Traps in Corriders[/h1]

[b]A new menu option is available in the 'Options' Menu[/b]

Traps by default is now set to 'Warning.'

Trap options:

[list]
    [*]Enable: Traps in corridors are enabled and no warning message prompt is displayed upon activating the traps. [b]Warning![/b] You may accidentally kill your entirely party if you activated the 'Burn' trap and continue to move really fast across the corridor.
    [*]Warning: Traps in corridors are enabled, when traps are activated, a message prompt is displayed.
    [*]Disable: Traps in corridors are disabled.
[/list]

Chance of triggering a trap is about 20%, approximately 1 in 5 corridors, 3 times a floor.

I decided to re-enable traps, but allow players to choose whether to turn them off or not.

With traps enabled, please be careful that you will need to rely on 'Cure' and Herbs that remove status ailment.

[b]Tower of Incarnation Traps[/b]

Floor 1 - 3 Traps

[list]
    [*]Chance of debuffing your party with a random negative status effect
    [*]Chance of teleporting to a random unvisited room
    [*]Chance of a barrage of poison arrows, dealing 20% of your max HP + low chance of applying level 1 Poison
[/list]

Floor 4 - 6 Traps

[list]
    [*]Chance of debuffing your party with a random negative status effect
    [*]Chance of teleporting to a random unvisited room
    [*]Chance of a barrage of poison arrows, dealing 20% of your max HP + low chance of applying level 2 Poison
    [*]Chance of a barrage of fire arrows, dealing 20% of your max HP + low chance of applying level 2 Burn
[/list]

Floor 7 - 10 Traps

[list]
    [*]Chance of debuffing your party with a random negative status effect
    [*]Chance of teleporting to a random unvisited room
    [*]Chance of a barrage of poison arrows, dealing 20% of your max HP + low chance of applying level 3 Poison
    [*]Chance of a barrage of fire arrows, dealing 20% of your max HP + low chance of applying level 3 Burn
    [*]Chance of a barrage of ice arrows, dealing 20% of your max HP + low chance of applying level 3 Freeze
    [*]Chance of a activating a spell, applying level 3 Poison to all your party members
    [*]Chance of a activating a spell, applying level 3 Burn to all your party members
    [*]Chance of a activating a spell, applying level 3 Freeze to all your party members
    [*]Chance of a activating a spell, applying level 3 Paralyze to all your party members
[/list]

Floor 11-15 Traps

[list]
    [*]Chance of debuffing your party with a random negative status effect
    [*]Chance of teleporting to a random unvisited room
    [*]Chance of a barrage of poison arrows, dealing 20% of your max HP + low chance of applying level 5 Poison
    [*]Chance of a barrage of fire arrows, dealing 20% of your max HP + low chance of applying level 5 Burn
    [*]Chance of a barrage of ice arrows, dealing 20% of your max HP + low chance of applying level 5 Freeze
    [*]Chance of a barrage of cursed arrows, dealing 20% of your max HP + low chance of applying level 5 Stop
    [*]Chance of a activating a spell, applying level 5 Poison to all your party members
    [*]Chance of a activating a spell, applying level 5 Burn to all your party members
    [*]Chance of a activating a spell, applying level 5 Freeze to all your party members
    [*]Chance of a activating a spell, applying level 5 Paralyze to all your party members
[/list]

[b]Pandemonium Traps[/b]

Floor 1 = same trap as Floor 7 - 10 Traps in Tower of Incarnation
The other floors = same trap as Floor 11-15, but all level 4 instead of 5.

Please provide feedback at http://steamcommunity.com/app/470300/discussions/0/152391285467573041/

Thank you!
